items: 【FHD Touchscreen】This Fujitsu Tablet Stylistic Q508 Laptop features a 10.1-inch FHD IPS touchscreen with 1920×1080 resolution. Supporting 10-point touch and a 360° flip design, it comes with a Japanese keyboard and one-touch switching between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes to meet diverse needs like presentations, handwritten notes, and multimedia entertainment.

【Powerful Performance】This Fujitsu Tablet Stylistic Q508 Touchscreen Laptop Computer features an Intel Atom x5-Z8550 processor, 4GB RAM + 64GB SSD high-speed storage, and front/rear cameras. It effortlessly handles multitasking, data analysis, video conferencing, and more with smooth, lag-free performance.

【Versatile Connectivity】This Fujitsu Tablet features Type-C (supporting charging/data transfer), USB ports, and a headphone jack to meet all-day mobile productivity needs. Its semi-rugged chassis design withstands harsh environments.

【Professional Operating System】This Fujitsu Tablet Stylistic Q508 Laptop comes pre-installed with Windows 11, delivering comprehensive enterprise-grade functionality and security. It supports enterprise features like BitLocker encryption and Remote Desktop, meeting the demands of professional users.

【Official Assurance】This Touchscreen Laptop Computer is meticulously refurbished by a qualified Amazon seller, ensuring excellent cosmetic and functional condition. It undergoes rigorous testing and thorough cleaning to guarantee like-new quality.
